nodes.title: receipt-engine barrel export
nodes.summary: Public barrel entry point for the receipt-engine package. Re-exports all client-facing types, layout, canvas rendering, and font utilities.
nodes.description: Aggregates and re-exports the receipt-engine's public API surface: all exports from types, layout, canvas, and fonts modules. Named re-exports include FONT_CSS, FONT_CACHE, fontFamilyCss from fonts and DEFAULT_FIELDS, FIELD_KEYS, FIELD_LABELS from types.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ES module re-export syntax (export * and named export { } from).
nodes.languageLesson: Barrel files centralize a package's public API, letting consumers import from one path. export * re-exports all named exports; selective export { } exposes only specific symbols.

nodes.title: receipt-engine server-side barrel
nodes.summary: Server-side barrel exporting PDF rendering functions, font file accessors, and Node-specific receipt types from the receipt-engine package.
nodes.description: Exposes server-only receipt-engine APIs: renderReceiptPdf, readMuktaFontFiles, FONT_FILES, nodeMeasure from pdf module, and ReceiptData and ReceiptTemplateView type exports from the types module.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes value exports and type-only exports (export type { }) from different internal modules.
nodes.languageLesson: export type { } performs type-only re-exports that are erased at compile time, keeping runtime bundles clean. This separates server-specific APIs (PDF rendering, Node fs) from the client barrel.

nodes.title: receipt-engine TypeScript config
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the receipt-engine package. Extends root base config, targets ESNext modules with Bundler resolution, outputs to dist/.
nodes.description: Configures TypeScript compilation for the receipt-engine package: extends ../../tsconfig.base.json, outputs to dist directory, uses ESNext module format with Bundler module resolution, includes Node.js type definitions, and scopes compilation to the src directory.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON config file consumed by the TypeScript compiler (tsc).
nodes.languageLesson: tsconfig.json extends a shared base config to reduce duplication in monorepos. module: ESNext + moduleResolution: Bundler is the modern pattern for bundler-managed builds (Vite, esbuild, etc.).

nodes.title: shared package manifest
nodes.summary: npm package manifest for @pavati/shared. Defines the package entry point, build/typecheck scripts, and declares zod as its sole runtime dependency.
nodes.description: Private ESM package (type: module) named @pavati/shared at version 0.1.0. Exports ./dist/index.js as main with TypeScript declarations. Scripts include build (tsc), dev (tsc --watch), and typecheck (tsc --noEmit). Runtime dependency: zod ^3.23.8 for schema validation. Dev dependency: typescript ^5.6.3.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON manifest consumed by npm/package managers.
nodes.languageLesson: The exports field with conditional types/import keys is the modern Node.js package entry point format. type: module enables native ESM. Private: true prevents accidental publishing.

nodes.title: shared package barrel export
nodes.summary: Public barrel entry point for the @pavati/shared package. Re-exports all constants, permissions, types, schemas, and utilities, plus zod and ZodSchema from the zod library.
nodes.description: Centralizes the shared package's public API by re-exporting everything from five internal modules (constants, permissions, types, schemas, utils) and selectively re-exporting z and ZodSchema from the zod dependency to provide a unified validation layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines wildcard re-exports (export *) with selective named re-exports and type re-exports.
nodes.languageLesson: Re-exporting third-party libraries (like zod) through a shared package ensures all consumers use a single version, avoiding duplicate dependency issues in monorepos.

nodes.title: shared utility functions
nodes.summary: Collection of shared utility functions for Indian currency formatting (INR), date localization, amount-to-words conversion, initials extraction, random code generation, and text slugification.
nodes.description: Provides six exported utility functions: formatINR (Indian Rupee currency formatting via Intl with optional compact notation), formatDate (ISO date to en-IN locale with optional time), amountInWords (converts numeric amount to Indian numbering words — Crore/Lakh/Thousand/Paise), initials (extracts up to 2 uppercase initials from a name), randomCode (cryptographically secure alphanumeric code generator), and slugify (normalizes text to URL-safe kebab-case slugs, max 40 chars).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Intl.NumberFormat for locale-aware currency, Web Crypto API (crypto.getRandomValues) for secure random generation, and ES module exports.
nodes.languageLesson: Intl.NumberFormat with currency: 'INR' and locale 'en-IN' handles Indian number grouping (lakhs/crores). amountInWords implements the Indian numbering system where grouping is by lakhs (100K) and crores (10M) rather than the Western thousands/millions. crypto.getRandomValues is a browser/Node Web Crypto standard for secure randomness.

nodes.title: shared package TypeScript config
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the @pavati/shared package. Extends root base config, targets ESNext modules with Bundler resolution, outputs to dist/.
nodes.description: Configures TypeScript compilation for the shared package: extends ../../tsconfig.base.json, outputs to dist directory, uses ESNext module format with Bundler module resolution, and scopes compilation to the src directory. No Node-specific type augmentation.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON config file consumed by the TypeScript compiler (tsc).
nodes.languageLesson: Nearly identical to the receipt-engine tsconfig but omits the Node types array — the shared package targets universal (browser+server) usage rather than Node-only.
